{"content":"import unittest

from poker import best_hands


class PokerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_and_single_hand(self):
        self.assertEqual(best_hands([]), [])
        hand = "4S 5H 6D 8C 10S"
        self.assertEqual(best_hands([hand]), [hand])

    def test_category_order(self):
        hands = [
            "AS KD 9H 6C 3S",  # High card
            "2S 2H AD KC QS",  # One pair
            "3S 3H 2D 2C AS",  # Two pair
            "2S 2H 2D AC KS",  # Three of a kind
            "AS 2H 3D 4C 5S",  # Straight
            "2H 4H 6H 8H 10H",  # Flush
            "2S 2H 2D 3C 3S",  # Full house
            "2S 2H 2D 2C AS",  # Four of a kind
            "2H 3H 4H 5H 6H",  # Straight flush
        ]
        for end in range(1, len(hands) + 1):
            with self.subTest(category=end):
                self.assertEqual(best_hands(hands[:end]), [hands[end - 1]])

    def test_tiebreakers(self):
        # Each pair lists the weaker hand first.
        cases = [
            ("AS KD 9H 6C 3S", "AH KC 9D 6S 4H"),
            ("2S 2H AD KC QS", "3S 3H 4D 5C 7S"),
            ("2S 2H AD KC JS", "2D 2C AH KS QS"),
            ("KS KH QD QC AS", "AS AH 2D 2C 3S"),
            ("KS KH 2D 2C AS", "KD KC 3D 3C 4S"),
            ("KS KH 2D 2C QS", "KD KC 2H 2S AS"),
            ("2S 2H 2D AC KS", "3S 3H 3D 4C 5S"),
            ("2S 2H 2D AC QS", "2S 2H 2D AC KS"),
            ("AS 2H 3D 4C 5S", "2S 3H 4D 5C 6S"),
            ("9S 10H JD QC KS", "10S JH QD KC AS"),
            ("AH KH 9H 6H 3H", "AS KS 9S 6S 4S"),
            ("2S 2H 2D AC AS", "3S 3H 3D 4C 4S"),
            ("3S 3H 3D 2C 2S", "3S 3H 3D 4C 4S"),
            ("2S 2H 2D 2C AS", "3S 3H 3D 3C 4S"),
            ("2S 2H 2D 2C KS", "2S 2H 2D 2C AS"),
            ("AH 2H 3H 4H 5H", "2S 3S 4S 5S 6S"),
        ]
        for weaker, stronger in cases:
            with self.subTest(weaker=weaker, stronger=stronger):
                self.assertEqual(best_hands([weaker, stronger]), [stronger])
                self.assertEqual(best_hands([stronger, weaker]), [stronger])

    def test_ties_preserve_input_order_and_strings(self):
        first = "6S  4D 3H 2C 5H"
        second = "2H 3D 4C 5S 6D"
        weaker = "AS 2H 3D 4C 5S"
        self.assertEqual(
            best_hands([first, weaker, second, first]),
            [first, second, first],
        )

    def test_suits_do_not_break_ties(self):
        hands = ["AH KH QH JH 10H", "10S JS QS KS AS"]
        self.assertEqual(best_hands(hands), hands)

    def test_ace_cannot_wrap_in_a_straight(self):
        invalid_straight = "QS KH AD 2C 3S"
        pair = "2S 2H 4D 6C 8S"
        self.assertEqual(best_hands([invalid_straight, pair]), [pair])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
